metadata.description: An engineering workflow for Claude Code. One idea goes in; a reviewed, integrated commit comes out.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Keeps a few things true on every task: work on its own branch, a green commit per step, behaviour driven on the running system before it is called done, a fresh bounded review, and the user asked at four points only. One git hook enforces the rules; grill, plan, epic and bug switch on when a task needs them.
